name: Barberà de la Conca (Spain)
description: Light blue field with two narrow white horizontal stripes across the centre.
history: The official flag of Barberà de la Conca is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light blue, with two white fesses each of thickness 1/12 of the height of the cloth and separated by a space of the same thickness, at the centre; approved by the municipal council on 23 October 2002 and published in the DOGC on 24 December 2002.

features.role: two narrow fesses of 1/12 separated by a space of the same width
